title: Sửa trạng thái tải và kích thước AR bàn 3D
rootCause: The modal only samples model-viewer's load and canActivateAR state through a post-render effect. Cached/fast models can already be loaded before listeners attach, leaving progress at 0% and the external AR button disabled while model-viewer's built-in AR control is active. The modal also sets ar-scale=fixed, preventing users from correcting oversized native AR placement.
